tagline: Designing and manufacturing memorialization products, performance materials, brand solutions, and warehouse automation systems
hero_kpi_rationale: The backlog is the primary indicator of revenue visibility, with delivery lead times up to 12 months for custom projects, reflecting structural demand in key segments such as warehouse automation and specialized equipment.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of unfilled orders awaiting production or installation.
kpis.description: The backlog is primarily expected to be delivered in 2026, with lead times varying from several weeks to over one year depending on segments (4-6 months for incineration, 9-12 months for mausoleums, over one year for custom projects).

kpis.name: Goodwill Write-down
kpis.explanation: Amount of goodwill impairment following a loss of value in a business segment.
kpis.description: A goodwill impairment charge of 16.7 M$ was recorded in the fourth quarter of 2024 (as of September 1, 2024) for the Surfaces and Engineering division, resulting from performance declines related to the acquisition of Olbrich GmbH in August 2022. Fair value was determined by discounted cash flow analysis.
kpis.signal: Sign of difficulties in a recent acquisition

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures to maintain and develop production capacity.
kpis.description: Capital investments are related to the maintenance of productive assets and capacity development in the industrial segments of memorialization, performance materials, and warehouse automation.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 5,200 people across more than 18 countries, supporting operations in memorialization, warehouse automation, and product identification segments.

kpis.name: Interest Rate Swaps
kpis.explanation: Notional amount of swap contracts used to hedge interest rate risk on variable rate debt.
kpis.description: The notional amount of interest rate swaps increased from 175 M$ as of September 30, 2024 to 225 M$ as of September 30, 2025, reflecting a 28.6% increase. The swaps are designated as cash flow hedges with a weighted average maturity of 2.7 years.
kpis.signal: Increased hedging against variable rate fluctuations

kpis.name: Cross Currency Swaps
kpis.explanation: Notional amount of swaps used to hedge foreign exchange risk on investments and foreign operations.
kpis.description: The notional amount of cross currency swaps totaled 126.4 M$ as of September 30, 2025, designated as net investment hedges in foreign operations. A 10% appreciation of the US dollar would reduce sales by 31.6 M$ and operating income by 2.3 M$.
kpis.signal: Partial hedging of multi-currency foreign exchange risks

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 6 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of 1.796 B$ in the last fiscal year (FY2024).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -0.024 B$ in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to cyber attacks and data breaches. Language in the report indicates that operations could be disrupted, resulting in legal claims, reputational damage, financial losses, and regulatory penalties. Compliance with data protection laws requires ongoing investments in systems and personnel.

risks.title: Regulatory Environment
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with continuously evolving federal, state, and local laws and regulations, including environmental protection and data privacy requirements. Non-compliance could result in fines and increased operating costs.

risks.title: Internal Controls and Financial Reporting
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain effective internal controls in compliance with Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act to ensure accuracy of financial reporting. A failure could result in restatements, loss of investor confidence, and negative impact on stock price.

risks.title: Litigation and Claims
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation and claims related to its operations. Such litigation could result in significant costs and material financial losses.

risks.title: Reputation and Trust
risks.score_rationale: The company must protect its reputation with customers and investors. Reputational harm from data breaches, security incidents, or compliance issues could result in revenue losses and loss of confidence.

risks.title: Technology Dependence and International Operations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in more than 18 countries and relies heavily on technology for operations. A technology failure, security breach, or complications in international operations could disrupt business and impact financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: MATW does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report for fiscal year 2025. No strategic, technological, or operational reference to AI is present.
